fusions.name: Carried Ember
fusions.desc: Throws an ember on a gust that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target are blown onto every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Flashover
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A gust feeds it into a flash that deals 9 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spinning Cinders
fusions.desc: Sets a column of embers spinning for 10 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it throws a cinder at an enemy within 5 tiles that deals 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bellows Lungs
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
